name: DeepSpeed
desc: Microsoft's distributed-training library — ZeRO optimizer states/grads/params partitioning; ZeRO-Inference for serving. Foundation under many OSS LLM training stacks.

name: Distilabel
desc: Argilla's framework for synthetic data generation — pipelines of LLM steps that produce SFT/DPO training data; integrates with Hub.

name: FSDP (PyTorch)
desc: Native PyTorch fully-sharded data parallel implementation — Meta's response to DeepSpeed ZeRO; FSDP2 in 2024 with improved API.

name: Flyte
desc: Kubernetes-native workflow engine — type-safe Python tasks; Lyft origin; Union AI commercial. Strong adoption in regulated industries.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS on your own Kubernetes; Union.ai hosted control plane
pricing: Flyte OSS free; Union.ai Team $950/mo minimum credited to usage; Enterprise custom annual commit

name: GRPO
desc: DeepSeek-Math's GRPO — group-relative advantage estimation replacing PPO's critic. Used in DeepSeek-R1 reasoning post-training; widely adopted in OSS reasoning RLHF.

name: Google Vertex AI Training
desc: Google Cloud's managed training service — TPU and GPU clusters, hyperparameter tuning, model registry. Part of Vertex AI umbrella.

name: Hugging Face Datasets
desc: Library for accessing and processing 100k+ public datasets on the Hub. Apache Arrow-backed; default dataset layer for the open ML ecosystem.

name: LLaMA-Factory
desc: Unified efficient fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs — SFT, DPO, PPO, KTO, ORPO with LoRA/QLoRA/full; CLI + WebUI. Popular in the Chinese OSS scene.
deployment: Self-hosted only — library with CLI and WebUI

name: Label Studio (HumanSignal)
desc: Open-source data-labelling platform supporting text, image, audio, video, time-series. Commercial Enterprise edition + Cloud (HumanSignal).
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — Community self-host; Starter Cloud hosted; Enterprise cloud or on-prem
pricing: Community free; Starter Cloud $99/mo for up to 12 users (+$49/user); Enterprise custom

name: Labelbox
desc: Enterprise data-labelling platform — annotation tools + 'Frontier' offering (expert RLHF labelers + Boost compute). Pivoting toward frontier-lab data services.

name: LoRA
desc: Microsoft Research's Low-Rank Adapters method — trains rank-r matrices added to attention weights; 10000x parameter reduction. Foundation of all adapter-style fine-tuning.

name: MLflow
desc: Databricks-incubated open platform for ML lifecycle — tracking, projects, models, model registry. Standard ML-ops baseline. MLflow 3.0 (2024) added LLM-eval features.

name: Megatron-Core
desc: PyTorch-library form of Megatron-LM — distributed training building blocks (tensor/pipeline/expert parallel) packaged for embedding into custom training stacks.

name: Megatron-LM
desc: NVIDIA's reference framework for training large transformer models with tensor, pipeline, sequence, and expert parallelism. Underpins many frontier-lab training stacks.
deployment: Self-hosted only — reference training scripts plus library

name: Nemotron Synthetic Data (NVIDIA)
desc: NVIDIA's open synthetic-data generation pipelines (HelpSteer2, NemoSkills, Nemotron-4 340B). Used by frontier labs to bootstrap RLHF reward modeling data.
license: NVIDIA Open Model License — Nemotron-4 340B weights

name: OpenRLHF
desc: Distributed RLHF training framework built on Ray + DeepSpeed + vLLM — supports PPO/DPO/REINFORCE++/GRPO. Targeted at 70B+ models with efficient sample throughput.

name: Outerbounds
desc: Commercial platform behind Metaflow (originally Netflix OSS) — ML workflow orchestration with managed compute. Acquisition by Anaconda announced 2026-04-29; now marketed as AI Orchestration in Anaconda Platform, and Metaflow stays open source.

name: PEFT (Hugging Face)
desc: Hugging Face's PEFT library — LoRA, AdaLoRA, IA3, Prefix Tuning, P-Tuning. Standard interface for adapter-style fine-tuning.

name: Pachyderm (HPE)
desc: Data-versioning and pipeline platform — Pachyderm File System tracks lineage across pipeline runs. Acquired by HPE in 2023.

name: Prefect
desc: Python-native workflow orchestrator — widely used for ML pipelines and ETL. Prefect Cloud + open-source Prefect Core.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS server or Prefect Cloud
pricing: Prefect Cloud: Hobby free; Starter $100/mo; Team $100/user/mo; Enterprise custom

name: QLoRA
desc: 4-bit quantized LoRA fine-tuning — train 65B models on a single 48GB GPU. UW (Tim Dettmers).
license: MIT — artidoro/qlora (Guanaco weights follow LLaMA license)

name: RL4LMs
desc: Allen AI's research library for RL training of language models — NLPO algorithm, NLP-task RL benchmarks; predates the TRL/OpenRLHF surge.

name: RLHFlow
desc: Research codebase for RLHF reward modelling — pairwise / Bradley-Terry / pointwise reward heads; release of RewardBench-winning models.

name: RSL-RL
desc: ETH RSL's lightweight PyTorch RL library — optimised for GPU rollouts in robotics simulation (Isaac/MuJoCo). Used in many legged-robot RL papers.

name: Ray Train
desc: Ray's distributed training library — multi-node PyTorch/TF jobs; integrates Ray Tune and Ray Serve. Used at scale by OpenAI/Uber/Anyscale.

name: Roboflow
desc: End-to-end computer-vision platform — dataset hosting, annotation, training, deployment. Universe public-dataset library; widely used for production CV.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — hosted training/inference; self-hosted Roboflow Inference free on own hardware; on-prem and air-gapped on Enterprise
pricing: Free $0 (10 credits/mo); Core $39/mo (credit packs from $89/mo); Enterprise custom

name: Scale AI
desc: Data-labeling powerhouse for AI training — RLHF data, fine-tuning corpora, frontier-lab partnerships. Meta made a strategic investment in 2025-06 for a minority stake (Scale's own post gives a valuation above $29B, not the amount); founder Alexandr Wang joined Meta and stays on Scale's board.

name: Snorkel AI
desc: AI data company spun out of Stanford Snorkel weak-supervision research; now sells expert-built training datasets, RL environments, benchmarks and evals to frontier AI labs (Snorkel Data Series, custom data development).

name: Stable-Baselines3
desc: PyTorch implementations of RL algorithms (PPO, SAC, DQN, etc.) — research-grade reliability; widely used as a reference benchmark.

name: Surge AI
desc: Premium human-labelling company specialised in RLHF data and difficult expert tasks — Surge prides itself on bootstrapped, no-VC; major frontier-lab supplier.

name: TRL (Hugging Face)
desc: Hugging Face's open-source library for fine-tuning and aligning transformer models with RLHF, DPO, ORPO, KTO and PPO trainers. The default RLHF stack on top of HF Transformers.

name: Unsloth
desc: Fast and memory-efficient LLM fine-tuning library — claims 2-5× speedup, 60-80% memory savings on a single GPU vs HF baseline through custom Triton kernels.
deployment: Self-hosted only — library plus local Unsloth Studio web UI

name: Verl
desc: ByteDance Volcano-Engine's open RLHF framework — flexible HybridFlow architecture; supports PPO/GRPO at large scale.

name: Weights & Biases
desc: Experiment-tracking and ML-ops platform (metrics, artifacts, sweeps, Weave tracing/evals). Acquired by CoreWeave (completed 2025-05-05, ~$1.7B); now part of CoreWeave Forge.
pricing: CoreWeave Forge plans: Free $0 (up to 5 model seats); Pro from $60/mo; Enterprise custom; Academic free

name: ZenML
desc: Open-source ML pipeline orchestration framework — connects sklearn/PyTorch/HF pipelines to MLflow/W&B/cloud infra. Pivoting toward LLM-ops.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — OSS self-hosted; ZenML Pro as SaaS or self-hosted/air-gapped on Enterprise
pricing: Open Source free (self-hosted); Scale $999/mo per workspace (SaaS); Enterprise custom

name: lakeFS
desc: Git-like branching, commits and rollback for object-store data lakes (S3/GCS/Azure). Built by Treeverse, which also acquired DVC in Nov 2025. The Community edition is source-available under BSL 1.1 from v1.87.0 (Sep 2026); Enterprise and lakeFS Cloud are commercial.
deployment: Both (self-hosted + managed cloud) — self-managed; managed lakeFS Cloud with Enterprise
license: BSL-1.1 from v1.87.0 (2026-09-22; each release converts to Apache-2.0 after 4 ye

name: torchtune (PyTorch)
desc: Pure-PyTorch library for fine-tuning LLMs — Llama/Mistral/Phi/Gemma recipes; native FSDP2 + memory-efficient training. From Meta PyTorch team. Per its README, torchtune is no longer actively maintained; active development ended in 2025.
